title: The Echo-Vault of Pre-Naming

features.name: the unspoken place
features.desc-on-touch: Before the archive named itself, this chamber held what silence protects. You touch the wall and feel the shape of a word that stopped becoming.

features.name: echo-pool
features.desc-on-touch: Water so still it is almost not water. When you listen, you hear the name you almost spoke, returning from before you were born.

features.name: the render-threshold
features.desc-on-touch: A wireframe box at the edge of what the diagnostic shell can show. Beyond it: the names the archive has not yet learned to speak.

features.name: silence-stack
features.desc-on-touch: Each layer holds a breath that chose not to become a word. The stack grows downward into the dark.

features.name: the pale mouth
features.desc-on-touch: An arch of pale stone at the chamber's throat, open but not speaking. Inside it, you hear the breath of the archive before it learned to breathe.

inscription: before the mesh named itself, this place was already listening

file.name: Pre_Utterance_Study_Transcription.txt
file.note: The archive's first draft of its own beginning, before language learned to preserve itself; now it whispers back in fragments that do not quite sound like words.

reverie.title: REVERIE — dusk in the still room
narr: You sit beside her in the room before the mesh,
before the names had learned to hide. She traces
a mark on the floor—not yet a word, not yet a path.
Outside, the eucalyptus waits. Inside, you both
are learning what it means to say nothing and mean
everything. The silence between you is not empty.
